scenes.caption: Calm Water Gel
scenes.say: Meet the Dermalogica Calm Water Gel. It is a weightless water-gel moisturizer made for dry, sensitive skin.

scenes.caption: Dual hyaluronic acid
scenes.say: It is formulated with dual hyaluronic acid: sodium hyaluronate, and hydrolyzed sodium hyaluronate.

scenes.caption: Locks in moisture
scenes.say: These two forms work in different layers of the skin surface, to increase moisture and lock it in.

scenes.caption: Water-gel texture
scenes.say: The weightless water-gel transforms into a skin-quenching fluid as you smooth it on.

scenes.caption: No added color or fragrance
scenes.say: It contains no artificial colors or fragrances, and it comes in a fifty milliliter jar. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Intensive Moisture Balance Review: Barrier Lipids & Hyaluronic Acid, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Intensive Moisture Balance: an ultra-nourishing moisturizer that restores lipid balance to dry, depleted skin.
items.hook: an ultra-nourishing moisturizer that restores lipid balance to dry, depleted skin.
facts: Ultra-nourishing moisturizer that restores lipid balance to dry, depleted skin
BioReplenish Complex of barrier lipids; prebiotic chlorella algae complex
Hyaluronic acid with echinacea, centella asiatica and aloe vera
After cleansing and toning, apply over face and neck in light, upward strokes, twice daily
Sizes: 15, 50, 100 and 150 ml; recommended for normal to dry skin

scenes.caption: Intensive Moisture Balance
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Intensive Moisture Balance. In the next couple of minutes, we will go through what it is, what is in it, who it is for, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: What it is
scenes.say: Intensive Moisture Balance is an ultra-nourishing moisturizer. Its job is to restore lipid balance to dry, depleted skin.

scenes.caption: Normal to dry skin
scenes.say: It is recommended for normal to dry skin. So if your skin feels dry or depleted, this is the kind of moisturizer it was made for.

scenes.caption: BioReplenish Complex
scenes.say: The first key ingredient is the BioReplenish Complex. This is a complex of barrier lipids, the same family of lipids that help skin hold on to moisture.

scenes.caption: Prebiotic chlorella
scenes.say: Next is a prebiotic chlorella algae complex. Chlorella is a type of algae, and here it is used as a prebiotic complex in the formula.

scenes.caption: Hyaluronic acid
scenes.say: The formula also includes hyaluronic acid, a well-known hydrating ingredient in skincare.

scenes.caption: Echinacea, centella, aloe
scenes.say: Alongside the hyaluronic acid, you will find echinacea, centella asiatica, and aloe vera.

scenes.caption: Step 1: cleanse and tone
scenes.say: Now, how to use it. Start with clean skin. Cleanse first, and then tone.

scenes.caption: Step 2: upward strokes
scenes.say: Then apply Intensive Moisture Balance over your face and neck, using light, upward strokes.

scenes.caption: Twice daily
scenes.say: Use it twice a day, so once in the morning and once at night, as the final step of your routine after cleansing and toning.

scenes.caption: Sizes
scenes.say: It comes in four sizes: fifteen, fifty, one hundred, and one hundred and fifty milliliters.

scenes.caption: Recap
scenes.say: So to recap: Intensive Moisture Balance is an ultra-nourishing moisturizer with barrier lipids, a prebiotic chlorella algae complex, and hyaluronic acid, made to restore lipid balance to dry, depleted skin. The link is in the description.

scenes.caption: UltraCalming Mist
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica UltraCalming Mist, a soothing, hydrating mist that helps calm redness and sensitivity.

scenes.caption: Oat and botanicals
scenes.say: It is made with the UltraCalming Complex, which combines oat and botanicals.

scenes.caption: Plus aloe
scenes.say: It also contains aloe, for a soothing, hydrating feel.

scenes.caption: Eyes closed
scenes.say: To use it, cleanse first. Then close your eyes and spray it over your face, neck and chest.

scenes.caption: Then serum or moisturizer
scenes.say: Let it absorb before you apply your serum or moisturizer. It comes in a 177 milliliter bottle. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Hyaluronic Ceramide Mist Review: 4 Hyaluronic Acids + Ceramide, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica Hyaluronic Ceramide Mist: a hydrating face mist with four types of hyaluronic acid and ceramide.
items.hook: a hydrating face mist with four types of hyaluronic acid and ceramide.
facts: Four types of hyaluronic acid help skin hold on to water for long-lasting hydration (150 ml)
Hyaluronic acid and ceramide help smooth the look of fine lines and strengthen the moisture barrier
Rose water with polyphenols and flavonoids helps revive and refresh
After cleansing, spray onto face and neck, avoiding the eyes; also a refreshing spritz during the day

scenes.caption: Hyaluronic Ceramide Mist
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Hyaluronic Ceramide Mist. In the next couple of minutes, we will cover what is in it, what it does, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: What it is
scenes.say: It is a hydrating face mist, in a one hundred and fifty milliliter bottle, built around hyaluronic acid and ceramide.

scenes.caption: 4 hyaluronic acids
scenes.say: The headline ingredient is hyaluronic acid. Not one type, but four types of hyaluronic acid.

scenes.caption: Long-lasting hydration
scenes.say: Together, these four types of hyaluronic acid help skin hold on to water, for long-lasting hydration.

scenes.caption: Ceramide
scenes.say: The second key ingredient is ceramide.

scenes.caption: Fine lines
scenes.say: Hyaluronic acid and ceramide together help smooth the look of fine lines.

scenes.caption: Moisture barrier
scenes.say: They also help strengthen the skin moisture barrier.

scenes.caption: Rose water
scenes.say: The third part of the formula is rose water, with polyphenols and flavonoids. It helps revive and refresh the skin.

scenes.caption: After cleansing
scenes.say: Here is how to use it. After cleansing, spray it onto your face and neck.

scenes.caption: Avoid the eyes
scenes.say: Keep it away from the eyes when you spray.

scenes.caption: During the day
scenes.say: You can also use it as a refreshing spritz during the day, whenever your skin needs it.

scenes.caption: Recap
scenes.say: So, the Hyaluronic Ceramide Mist: four types of hyaluronic acid, ceramide, and rose water, for long-lasting hydration and a stronger moisture barrier. The link is in the description.
